html:
[Hypothesis]

  • \(\mathsf{NSPACE}\) and \(\mathsf{coNSPACE}\) (nondeterministic space and complement classes, see 73-df-nondeterministic-work-space)
  • \(\operatorname{SpaceConstructible}\) (full space constructibility)

[Assertion]

[Remark]

版本归属：新版之外的拓展。 本条不作为所提供第三版 PDF 的正文陈述；原始来源以 source_id/source_ref 为准。

  • Inductive counting verifies the number of configurations reachable within successive path lengths while storing only a constant number of configurations and \(O(s(n))\)-bit counters. This recognizes nonreachability in the same asymptotic space.
  • The original atom's 28 automata-and-grammar dependencies were unrelated; only nondeterministic space and its constructibility condition enter the theorem.

来源更正：本结果发表于 1988 年，作为后续补充保留，不属于 1979 年本书。出版方陈述见 Immerman 原论文；本次核对了发表信息与定理摘要，未逐行核验原论文证明。

math.tex:
\mathrm{thm\text{-}immerman\text{-}szelepcsenyi}\vdash
\forall s:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N_{>0}\;\Bigl(
\operatorname{SpaceConstructible}(s)
\land\bigl(\forall n\in\mathbb N\;
\lceil\log_2(n+2)\rceil\leq s(n)\bigr)
\longrightarrow
\mathsf{NSPACE}(s)=\mathsf{coNSPACE}(s)
\Bigr)
